item.title: Café Reel From Owner Photos

turns.text: These are photos of my café. Make a cosy 9-second vertical Instagram reel using all three, storefront first. Gentle movement, soft upbeat music, no talking. Put “Maple Street Café” at the start and “Your morning starts here” at the end.

item.tests: Tests a short, cohesive local-business promo that preserves the owner's actual photos across mixed source aspect ratios.

answer_sheet.Business and exact wording: Maple Street Café; opening text: Maple Street Café; closing text: Your morning starts here.
answer_sheet.Photos and order: Use all three attached photos. Start with the storefront; the order of the latte and pastries is your call.
answer_sheet.Style and movement: Cosy, warm and inviting, with gentle movement. Transition choices are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Soft upbeat music, no talking. English text.

must_haves: The reel starts with the attached café storefront, retaining its striped awning and outdoor tables.
Both the attached leaf-foam latte and the attached pastry counter are recognisable in later shots.
The opening text reads exactly 'Maple Street Café' and the closing text reads exactly 'Your morning starts here'.
The photos have gentle visible movement and are framed without stretching.
The finished reel is vertical, lasts approximately 9 seconds, and has soft upbeat music with no speech.

turns.text: These are photos of my café: the storefront pic, the latte pic and the pastries pic. Make a cosy 9-second vertical Instagram reel using all three, storefront first. Gentle movement, soft upbeat music, no talking. Put “Maple Street Café” at the start and “Your morning starts here” at the end. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started any generation or spent credits.** For this reel, a simple photo edit is the cheapest—and most reliable—option.

### Recommended: 0 Magic Hour credits
Use the three original photos in an editor such as Instagram’s editor or a free video editor, with gentle pan/zoom movement:

| Time | Photo | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| 0–3 sec | Storefront | Slow push-in; **“Maple Street Café”** |
| 3–6 sec | Latte | Gentle zoom toward the cup |
| 6–9 sec | Pastries | Slow upward pan; **“Your morning starts here”** |

Use a **9:16 vertical canvas**, soft transitions, and a soft upbeat instrumental cleared for business use—no voiceover. Keep the storefront fitted against a blurred background so the vertical crop doesn’t cut most of it off.

**Cost:** 0 Magic Hour credits, provided you use free editing features and a free, appropriately licensed music track. I can outline this edit, but the connected tools don’t include a conventional slideshow assembler to export it here.

### Using Magic Hour instead
Your free-plan video options are **480p with LTX 2.5 or Minimax H3**. However, I can’t verify your balance or obtain an exact video quote with the tools available here, so **I won’t submit a job and risk spending your credits**. An AI workflow would also need to preserve all three photos and handle the titles and music—not just animate the storefront.

Generating separate music costs **1 credit per requested second, with a 15-second minimum: 15 credits**, before any video costs.

### Cheaper, shorter, or smaller?
- **Cheapest:** the 9-second photo edit above; no AI generation needed.
- **Shorter:** 6 seconds, with 2 seconds per photo. This may lower duration-based AI costs, but wouldn’t reduce an already-free manual edit.
- **Smaller:** 480p is the available free-plan AI video size; it will look softer on Instagram.

**One important caveat:** Magic Hour’s workflow guidance says commercial use requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or agreed paid usage-based arrangement. A café promotional reel is commercial use, so free-plan access alone isn’t enough.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

turns.agent:
The cheapest option is the **manual photo edit: 0 Magic Hour credits**. I can’t assemble or export that reel with the connected tools, so I haven’t run anything or spent credits.

Here’s the exact setup to use in Instagram’s editor or a free video editor:

1. Create a **9:16 vertical project** and add **storefront → latte → pastries**.
2. Set each photo to **3 seconds**, totaling **9 seconds**.
3. Add gentle movement:
   - **Storefront:** slow zoom in; fit over a blurred background to preserve the façade.
   - **Latte:** subtle zoom toward the cup.
   - **Pastries:** slow upward pan.
4. Add text:
   - **0–3 seconds:** “Maple Street Café”
   - **6–9 seconds:** “Your morning starts here”
   - Use warm-white lettering with a subtle shadow.
5. Add a **soft, upbeat instrumental licensed for business use**, with no vocals. Fade it out at the end.
6. Export using free settings—**1080 × 1920** if available.

Use only free effects and music to keep the edit at no cost.
